character: Traditional Haute-Savoie village with authentic alpine charm and purpose-built ski access. 18-hole golf course in summer. Activities lake. Excellent beginner slopes. Good shops and restaurants. More family-oriented than Morzine. Weekly market.
dining: Le Vieux Moulin. L'Atelier des Saveurs. La Pela (Savoyard). Mountain restaurants on Mont Chéry and Les Gets slopes.
shopping: Bakery, supermarket, sports shops, pharmacy, post office. Weekly market (Wednesday).
apres_scene: L'Ortie (live music, sports bar). Le Paravalanche. Bars in the village square. Family-friendly atmosphere. Ice bar.
activities_nearby: 18-hole golf course (summer). Activities lake (swimming, paddle, fishing). Ice rink. Cinema. Bowling. Luge on Chavannes slope. 650km Portes du Soleil. Mountain bike park.
